notes: §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR3 requires that 'Identifier-4 may be described as either the category alphabetic, alphanumeric, or numeric (except that the symbol 'P' may not be used in the PICTURE character-string), and must be described implicitly or explicitly, as USAGE IS DISPLAY.' BindUnstring asks UnstringReceiverAllowed of every elementary INTO receiver at every edition (no edition arm): it admits an unedited alphanumeric or alphabetic picture, and a numeric one only when usage DISPLAY, not float and HasPScaling false, and reports COBOL1626 otherwise; the predicate's 2023-only national arm is unreachable at 85 because national data is refused there (COBOL0900, national-data-2002). Probed at --std 85: PIC A, X, 9, S9 SIGN SEPARATE, 9V9 and a group receiver are accepted and run; COMP, BINARY, COMP-3, PACKED-DECIMAL, 99PP, PP99, numeric-edited, alphanumeric-edited (X(2)BX(2), A(2)BA), USAGE INDEX and an item under a USAGE COMP group are each COBOL1626. The witness refuses a PIC 9(4) COMPUTATIONAL receiver with COBOL1626.

next.reason: 1985: "must be described implicitly or explicitly, as USAGE IS DISPLAY."; 2023: "or as usage national and category national or numeric.". Both allow display alphabetic, alphanumeric or numeric items without 'P'. 2023 also accepts usage national items of category national or numeric, an added case.
